  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}"}

>

Changes one or more properties. Send only what you want to change: omitted fields are left
alone and are not validated.

Three fields reset rather than clear when you send an empty string: `Alias` returns to the
login name, `HomeDirectory` to `/home/{UserName}`, and `ChrootDirectory` to `/`.

Inbound rules take effect only if your plan includes them. On a plan without them, a change to
`Settings.Network.InboundRules` is skipped without an error, and the rest of the update still
applies.

Changes take effect on the next connection; sessions already open are not interrupted. To
change the password, use the password-rotation endpoint instead.
